subject.title: [Feature]: Per-user heartbeat routing for channel-level heartbeat messages

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel/account-level heartbeat recipient contract for OK acknowledgments only, separate from normal heartbeat alert/content delivery?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-proven, but adding public channel config changes config surface, precedence, validation, and the boundary between agent-level heartbeat delivery and channel-level visibility.

options.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
options.body: Add a narrow target/targets-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

options.title: Reject new config surface
options.body: Document the existing choices, such as showOk false for silence or agent-level heartbeat target/to when all heartbeat delivery should go to one recipient.

options.title: Defer to cross-channel design
options.body: Keep this as design input while maintainers choose a broader heartbeat recipient model instead of a WhatsApp-specific field.

recommendation.title: Approve OK-only recipient config
recommendation.body: Add a narrow target/targets-style channel or account heartbeat recipient shape that applies only to HEARTBEAT_OK acknowledgments and validates through WhatsApp account/allowlist policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current blame, prior review context, and recent config/outbound routing history on the affected surfaces.
